messages.text: Online request handling and cost tracking fixes are all in

One thing I keep running into: before a re-run, people want to know how much is already on disk, and right now the only way to find out is to start the run and watch the cache hits go by on the progress bar, which is too late to actually decide anything
Does anyone actually know what's on disk before kicking off a re-run, or is everyone just starting it and watching the hit counter?
Has anyone gotten an actual user request for a pre-run cache coverage check, or is this just something we keep hitting ourselves?
Got at least one user report on this. Someone asked why they couldn't see how many rows were cached before deciding whether to re-run a job, so this isn't just internal friction
Honestly I'm not sure this warrants a whole separate command vs. just a flag you can pass before committing to a run
Is this something we want to scope out this week, or does it go in the backlog?
that settles the user need question at least
The cache hit count is already computable before the first request goes out, it just isn't surfaced anywhere in the startup output
oh that's actually straightforward then

I'd lean toward filing it before we lose the thread, but honestly I'm not sure "just print it at startup" is the whole answer, the format question alone is probably worth thinking about. Do we want to open something or just let it sit?
Answering my own question I guess, filing it makes sense just to have it written down
Where does the cache state actually live at startup, is it read from disk before any requests are dispatched or is it lazy?
Cache state is read from disk at job init, before any requests go out.
@Gideon where does the issue filing stand, did you open something or is that still pending?
Haven't filed anything yet, I thought you were picking that up since you were the one who mentioned it
Happy to open it if not, just say the word
@Dario go ahead and file it if you want, I'll add the caching details once it's up
Go ahead and file it, do you have enough on the cache read side to write it up or do you need anything from me?
I've got enough to write it up, I'll file it.
Good to get this confirmed: the only way to know how much is already on disk right now is to kick off the run and watch the hit counter go by, which is already too late to make a decision
User report makes it real
